name: Mirage 404 Heatmap & Logs
author: Richard Psytes

sections.description:
Thank you for choosing Mirage 404!
This plugin gives you a clear, actionable overview of your site’s “Page Not Found” (404) errors, helping you improve user experience and protect SEO.

Broken links (404 errors) are more than just an annoyance; they’re dead ends for visitors and red flags for search engines. Mirage 404 provides an all-in-one solution to not only find these broken links but also understand their impact with an interactive heatmap.

Features (Free Version)

  • Interactive 404 Heatmap (color intensity, organic patterns, tooltips)
  • Detailed 404 Logs (sortable, IP tracking, referrer URLs)
  • Lightweight and fast – no performance impact

Upgrade to Pro

Unlock more power with Mirage 404 Pro!
The free version helps you find problems. Pro helps you fix them instantly.

  • Full Redirect Manager (301/302)
  • One-Click IP Blocker
  • Proactive Email Alerts
  • And much more!

Learn More About Pro

Support

  • Free support is available at the WordPress.org forums
  • For priority support, please consider upgrading to Pro at http://mirageheatmap.store

Source Code

This plugin uses a compiled version of the h337 heatmap.js library. The original, un-minified source code for this library is included in the /admin/js/src/ directory of the plugin.
sections.installation:
From your WordPress Dashboard

  1. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  2. Search for Mirage 404 Heatmap & Logs
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate
  4. A new Mirage 404 menu item will appear and begin logging errors

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin .zip file from WordPress.org
  2. In your dashboard, go to Plugins > Add New
  3. Click the Upload Plugin button
  4. Select the downloaded .zip file, click Install Now, then Activate
sections.faq:
Does this plugin slow down my site?

No. Mirage 404 is lightweight and has zero performance impact on your live site. Logging happens in the background.

How does the heatmap work?

It groups identical URLs from your logs and plots them visually. The more hits a URL has, the hotter (redder/brighter) the spot becomes.

Can I clear the logs?

Yes. You can delete logs individually or in bulk. The Pro version adds a one-click “Clear All Logs” option.
